findings.claim: The summary's "Open gaps" list keeps the CI bullet but drops its gap ("not yet applied"), so it now lists a closed item as open, and "gets Vault" reads worse than the "logs in to Vault" it replaced.

verdict.text: The change does what the plan says.

The new `tailscale-identity` step reads `sub` from an OIDC token with an untrusted audience, picks the immutable-subject client for `repo:JasperHG90@8079803/` and the legacy one otherwise, and leaves explicit inputs alone.
The Vault role and the prefix map are applied live.
One non-blocking docs finding: the summary bullet sits under "Open gaps" but no longer names a gap.
`loopctl gate stamp` from the worktree: pre_commit pass, cli_tests pass, r1 to r4 pass, stamp green 8492c94ac04c925f19feee05e7e9863e4219c46e8386d1c33f0c401b9743368b.
r1: the test runs the real step script with a stubbed curl returning a JWT, parametrized over both subject formats, and asserts exact client ID and audience outputs.
Swapping either branch fails it.
The test payloads hold no `-` or `_`, so the url-safe `tr` is not exercised there.
I checked it by hand with a payload that has both, and it decodes.
The spike also ran it against a real token.
r2: explicit client and audience come back unchanged for both formats, and the test asserts curl was never called.
r3: asserts the rendered role's four bound claims and `ov_sync`, not the source text.
r4: parses the prefix map and asserts it equals exactly the two entries.
r5 (judgment): the how-to drops the second-identity step and the Tailscale inputs, steps renumber 1 to 4 without gaps, and the skeleton test passes.
The reference adds a picking-rule table.
ADR 0031 amends 0027's consequence, and `git diff HEAD` shows ADR 0027 unchanged.
`kmctl check` passes.
r6 (judgment): I re-ran `vault read auth/jwt-github/role/loop-engineering-harness-openviking-sync`.
bound_claims are repository JasperHG90/loop-engineering-harness, ref refs/heads/main, environment lab, and workflow_ref .../openviking-sync.yaml@refs/heads/main.
Policies are default and ci-ov-sync-loop-engineering-harness-openviking-sync, ttl 300.
The live ov-sync-consumer job spec contains the loop-engineering-harness prefix.
Grepped the repo for stale "second identity" and old-default references.
The component page and the reference agree with the action.
f1: `.okf/summary.md` lists the CI bullet under "Open gaps".
The edit removed "not yet applied", which was the only gap it named, so it now describes a working feature as open.
Move it out of the list or name what is still open, and restore "logs in to Vault".
Non-blocking: a plain text fix.
If the token has no `sub`, `jq -er '.sub'` exits under `set -e` without a `::error::` line.
That is acceptable, since GitHub always sets `sub`.
